text:
Devon: FYI — FinCorp (large EU bank) wants an EU-only POC. Legal just flagged subprocessor + routing policy questions. Can sales + security confirm if we can guarantee tenant traffic stays in EU and whether BYO-KMS is possible for a hosted POC? They want cost delta and an explicit fallback behavior.

Asha: Customer prefers hosted for speed of onboarding, but their security lead says 'data must not leave EU under any circumstances'. They haven't signed the DPA yet; procurement is slow.

Luca: Quick clarification — by "hosted EU-only" do they expect the control plane to also be EU? Hosted currently has control-plane signals in us-east for metrics; data path can be pinned to EU regions. That distinction matters for legal.

Priya: Security checklist: 1) full subprocessor list for EU-only footprint (which cloud regions + any third-party monitoring/telemetry vendors) 2) BYO-KMS support details. Short answer: BYO-KMS is supported for Dedicated and Private; hosted BYO-KMS is limited (we can do envelope keys with partner HSM in some contracts). I'll validate specifics.

Devon: FinCorp specifically asked for a routing policy snippet they can attach to their security questionnaire: "tenant_pin -> eu-west-1, no egress to non-EU; if eu capacity unavailable, reject requests". Is that something we can promise for hosted?

Luca: For hosted we can do tenant affinity to EU region for inference/data path. However, we cannot promise reserved capacity (latency SLOs) unless they go Dedicated. Also the "reject on capacity" behavior is supported as a residency enforcement mode (product flag: residency.fail_mode = reject). I'll paste an example runbook block for ops: 

```
# routing policy (example)
residency:
  tenant_id: fincorp-123
  allowed_regions: [eu-west-1, eu-central-1]
  primary_region: eu-west-1
  fail_mode: reject   # options: reject | fallback
  subprocessors_allowed: [aws-eu-west-1, gcp-europe-west2]
```

Priya: Note: legal will still ask for subprocessors' certifications. I can attach iso27001 / soc2 mappings for the EU regions and list any downstream vendors. Also highlight that control-plane telemetry endpoints are in us-east unless we go Private (control-plane in EU).

ops-bot: Ticket created: SR-2798 — "Subproc attestation + EU pin runbook". Assigned: eng-infra, security. ETA: 48h for initial attestation bundle.

Jamal: I can take point with FinCorp procurement to get the DPA signed and confirm acceptance of 'reject on capacity' behavior. If they insist on hosted + strict residency + BYO-KMS, they'll likely need a short Dedicated commitment for the POC.

Asha: Pricing ask from sales: what's the delta for EU-tenant pin + BYO-KMS onboarding (one-time) + monthly key management fee? Also need estimate if they require reserved capacity for the POC (3x expected peak qps).

Devon: Rough numbers to start: EU tenant pin (hosted affinity) — no baseline fee but subject to admitting capacity; Dedicated reserved POC (small pool) ~ $3k/mo. BYO-KMS onboarding ~ $10k one-time + $500/mo key management. If they require Private control plane + on-prem proxy, add enterprise onboarding. I'll confirm exact pricing with finance.

Priya: Operational constraint: for hosted we cannot guarantee complete control-plane residency; if that's a blocker, propose Dedicated or Private. Also add a clear clause in the SOW about fail_mode=reject for residency-critical workloads.

Luca: Action items summary: 
- Priya: compile subprocessor list + cert attachments (ISO/SOC) and confirm BYO-KMS limitations for hosted vs dedicated.
- Devon: confirm pricing & create product/price breakdown for Asha to share with customer.
- ops-bot / eng-infra: draft runbook + sample routing policy + test steps (SR-2798).
- Jamal: engage procurement to push DPA and confirm whether they accept fail_mode=reject.

Devon: I'll DM FinCorp to ask whether they'd accept Dedicated POC if hosted can't meet strict control-plane residency. ETA: EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Asha: Thanks — I'll schedule a short call with FinCorp security for tomorrow afternoon once we have Priya's subproc list.

Priya: Got it, will upload cert bundle to the ticket in ~24h.

Luca: I'll draft the runbook and paste into SR-2798 by EOD.

Devon: Good progress — tagging @ops-bot @Priya @Luca for visibility.

ops-bot: Reminder: please attach SSO-safe copies of certs; do not include production keys in the ticket.
